title: Sum of Digits in the Minimum Number
description: Given an integer array `nums`, return `0`* if the sum of the digits of the minimum integer in *`nums`* is odd, or *`1`* otherwise*.

examples.explanation: The minimal element is 1, and the sum of those digits is 1 which is odd, so the answer is 0.
The minimal element is 33, and the sum of those digits is 3 + 3 = 6 which is even, so the answer is 1.
